h1: The 8 Best 2-Drawer Nightstands of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: 8 two-drawer nightstands compared on capacity, charging, LED options and finish, from a 100 lb Yoobure to a matched pair.
summary: The Yoobure 2-Drawer Vintage Brown is the best two-drawer nightstand: FCC and ETL certified wiring, two USB and two outlets with a 6.5 ft cord, and a stated 100 lb capacity, the highest of the charging tables. For no electronics at all, the WLIVE rustic brown is the simple pick. For LED fans, the Huuger offers 60,000 colors. And the Nathan James set gives you a matched pair with a lifetime warranty.
intro: A two-drawer nightstand is the standard bedside answer: enough storage for the basics, small enough for most rooms. The differences are in what surrounds the drawers: power, lighting, capacity and whether you are buying one table or two.

We reviewed eight current models on paper. Seven are single tables and one is a set of two. Ranking starts with power and capacity, then build and certification, then finish and extras like LED. Where a listing leaves a spec out, we say so.

products.name: Yoobure 2-Drawer Vintage Brown Nightstand, FCC & ETL Certified, 100 lb Capacity
products.verdict: FCC and ETL certified charging with a 100 lb capacity rating.
products.description:
Yoobure measures 15.75 x 11.81 x 23.62 inches in engineered wood and steel with two fabric drawers. It has two USB ports, two outlets and a 6.5 ft cord, and lists FCC and ETL certification with a 100 lb capacity.

It wins because it is the only certified model in the list and has the highest capacity among the charging tables. The Huuger tables offer more lighting but no certification.

Buy it for a heavily used bedside. The caveat is that it has only basic charging, no USB-C.

products.name: Huuger 2-Drawer Black Nightstand with 60,000-Color LED and USB-C
products.verdict: 60,000 colors, 12 scene modes, music sync and USB-C in a black table.
products.description:
Huuger measures 15.7 x 11.8 x 23.6 inches in P2 particleboard and powder-coated steel with two fabric drawers. It has two AC outlets, a USB-A and a USB-C port, plus an LED with 60,000 colors, 12 scene modes, music sync and app control.

It ranks second because it has the most lighting options and includes USB-C. It gives up the certification and capacity of the Yoobure.

Best for LED fans. The caveat is that lighting is a luxury.

products.name: Huuger 2-Drawer Rustic Brown Nightstand with USB-C
products.verdict: The same Huuger charging layout in rustic brown with a stain-resistant top.
products.description:
This Huuger measures 15.7 x 11.8 x 23.6 inches with P2 particleboard and a powder-coated steel frame, two fabric drawers, two AC outlets, a USB-A and a USB-C port, and a stain-resistant top.

It ranks third because it has the Huuger power layout without the LED extras. It beats plain tables on charging.

Best for a rustic bedroom that needs power. The caveat is no capacity rating on the listing.

products.name: WLIVE 2-Drawer White Nightstand with RGB LED, 3 USB Ports, 55 lb Capacity
products.verdict: Three USB ports and two outlets with a 55 lb capacity and a waterproof top.
products.description:
WLIVE measures 15.67 x 11.73 x 25.19 inches in MDF and steel, with two fabric drawers, three USB ports and two AC outlets. It has an RGB LED via the iStrip+ app, a waterproof top and a 55 lb capacity.

It ranks fourth because the port count and height are strong, but capacity trails the Yoobure.

Best for a white bedroom. The caveat is a reliance on an app for the LED.
products.idealFor: White bedrooms with lots of devices.
products.skipIf: You do not want an app.

products.name: Furologee 2-Drawer White Nightstand with S-Hooks, 50 lb Capacity
products.verdict: Two shelves, two drawers and S-hooks, at a lower 22.25 inch height.
products.description:
Furologee measures 11.75 x 14.96 x 22.25 inches in engineered wood and metal, with two fabric drawers, two shelves, two outlets, two USB ports and two S-hooks. The capacity is 50 lb.

It ranks fifth because the S-hooks and shelves add flexibility, and the lower height suits low platform beds.

Best for low beds. The caveat is the middling capacity.

products.name: WLIVE 2-Drawer Rustic Brown Nightstand
products.verdict: No electronics, four self-leveling feet and about 15 minutes of assembly.
products.description:
WLIVE measures 15.7 x 11.8 x 20.9 inches in MDF and steel, with two fabric drawers, a water-resistant top, four self-leveling feet and roughly 15 minutes of assembly. It has no charging ports.

It ranks sixth because the plain build avoids electrical parts. It has the least to go wrong.

Best for a minimal bedside. The caveat is no power.

products.name: Sweetcrispy 2-Drawer White Nightstand
products.verdict: The cheapest here, with end-stop drawers and a water-resistant top.
products.description:
Sweetcrispy measures 18 x 11.8 x 20 inches with a metal frame and engineered wood, two fabric drawers, arch handles and end-stop design. It has a 44 lb capacity, no charging and about 15 minutes of assembly.

It ranks seventh because it is the plainest and shortest, but it is the cheapest.

Best for a low budget. The caveat is no power.

products.name: Nathan James Harper Oak Brown Nightstand Set of 2, Lifetime Warranty
products.verdict: A set of two with a lifetime warranty and a 100-day money back offer.
products.description:
Nathan James sells a set of two, each 16 x 16 x 23.5 inches in MDF, particleboard and pinewood, with two easy-glide drawers, brass hardware and tapered pinewood legs. The listing includes a lifetime warranty and a 100-day money back offer, with no charging ports.

It ranks last only because it is a set and has no power. It is the most design-forward option.

Best for a pair in a styled bedroom. The caveat is the larger footprint.
products.idealFor: A styled pair of bedside tables.
products.skipIf: You need power or a narrow table.

whatMatters.detail: Capacity here runs from 44 lb to 100 lb. A lamp, books and a clock can add up. Aim for at least 50 lb.
Wiring in furniture should carry a safety mark. Only the Yoobure lists FCC and ETL. Check the listing.
A phone, tablet and lamp need three connections. Check outlets and USB counts.
A 20 inch table suits a low bed, a 25 inch table a taller one. Measure your mattress top.
Fabric drawers are light and removable but hold less weight than wood. Use for small items.

faq.q: What is the best two-drawer nightstand?
faq.a: The Yoobure, for certified charging and a 100 lb capacity.
The Huuger tables list USB-C. The Yoobure lists two USB ports without specifying USB-C.
For small items, yes. The listing capacity is the limit.
An electrical safety mark. The Yoobure is the only listing here with FCC and ETL.

faq.q: Is a set better than a single?
faq.a: For a matched look, yes. The Nathan James set comes with a lifetime warranty.
The WLIVE rustic brown and Sweetcrispy list about 15 minutes.

finalTake: For most bedrooms, the Yoobure 2-Drawer Vintage Brown is the right buy: certified wiring and a 100 lb capacity. For lighting, take the Huuger black. For a plain table, the WLIVE rustic brown. For a pair, the Nathan James set has a lifetime warranty.
